use_case_name: Create and Print a Voucher Batch

claims.content: To create a batch of vouchers and print them for distribution to clients via distributors.

goal.raw_text: To create a batch of vouchers and print them for distribution to clients via distributors.

claims.content: VMU User
The VMU User must be logged into the system with appropriate permissions to create and print voucher batches.
The system must have a master table structure in place to support dropdown selections for minimizing data entry errors during voucher creation.
The database must be operational and accessible, as voucher creation involves storing transaction details in the database.
User privileges must be configured to allow printing of reports or documents, since printing is permission-based.
The VMU User initiates the creation of a new voucher batch for distribution to clients via distributors.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates the creation of a new voucher batch for distribution to clients via distributors.

claims.content: The VMU User accesses the Voucher Creation module within the system.
The system presents data entry screens with dropdown selection menus to minimize data entry errors, as per the system design for user-friendliness.
The VMU User enters voucher batch details using the provided interface, selecting from master tables where applicable.
The system saves the entered voucher batch information into the database, which is structured with sequential links and surrogate keys for efficiency.
The VMU User initiates the print function for the created voucher batch.
The system checks the user’s login permissions before allowing the print operation, as print options are based on User Login Permission only.
If permitted, the system generates and outputs the printed voucher batch for distribution to clients via distributors.
If the user attempts to print the voucher batch but lacks the required User Login Permission, the system denies the print operation.

If duplicate distributor names are encountered during voucher batch setup or distribution assignment, the system displays a warning message prompting the user to either accept the duplicate name with a differentiating indicator or change the name.
If the user attempts to delete any associated records (e.g., distributor or batch details) before printing, deletion is only allowed if no child records have been created.
If the VMU User attempts to create a voucher batch with duplicate distributor IDs, the system will detect and flag the duplication as an error condition.

Upon detecting a duplicate distributor ID during voucher batch creation, the system shall prevent saving the record until the user resolves the duplication by either changing the name or adding a differentiating indicator.
If the VMU User lacks sufficient login permissions to print the voucher batch, the system shall block the print operation and may display an access denied message.

If the database is unavailable or encounters an error during voucher batch save (e.g., due to structural integrity issues like missing surrogate keys or defragmentation failures), the system shall abort the transaction and notify the user.
The voucher batch information is saved in the database with sequential links and surrogate keys for storage efficiency.
The printed voucher batch is generated and output only if the VMU User has the required User Login Permission.
If duplicate distributor names were encountered during batch setup, a warning was issued and either accepted with a differentiating indicator or resolved by changing the name.
No child records (e.g., sales or distribution assignments) are deleted unless explicitly allowed under the condition that no child records exist.
